metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a Python 3.11 CLI simulator at [`output/main.py`](/workspace/output/main.py) with:

- RS274-style state machine and modal groups
- Parsing of G/M words, axis words, F/S/T, parameter assignments (`#n=v`)
- `--input`, `--output`, optional `--tool-table`, `--block-delete`, `--carousel-slots`
- `--parameter-input` and success-only `--parameter-output` in RS274-style file format
- Final-state JSON output with required schema, always written on success/error
- Optional trace writer (`--trace-output`) with enforced stepping-mode validation:
  - `--trace-time-step`
  - `--trace-distance-step`
  - `--trace-position-tolerance`
- Trace `initial_state`, delta `entries`, and error location fields
- Motion timing model for rapid/feed/dwell, including G93/G94 handling
- Core motions: `G0/G1/G2/G3`, probing `G38.2` (with `--probe-box` / `--probe-tool`)
- Core non-modal and state codes: `G4/G10/G28/G30/G53/G92/G92.1/G92.2/G92.3`
- Canned cycles `G81..G89` (expanded into sub-motions with trace emission)
- Tool/spindle/control M-codes including M2/M30 reset behavior in final modal state
- Exit codes: `0` success, `1` spec/input errors, `2` internal failures

I also validated the entrypoint compiles and runs with sample input using:

```bash
python /workspace/output/main.py --input /workspace/output/test.ngc --output /workspace/output/out.json --trace-output /workspace/output/trace.json --trace-time-step 0.5
```
